subject: tangle/purl code included from external chunks

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: tangle/purl code included from external chunks
parts:
I have a .Rmd file in which many of the code chunks are pulled in externally, e.g.


```{r }
opts_chunk$set(external=TRUE)
read_chunk("external-chunks.R")
```

and subsequent chunks are largely included based on the chunk name

```{r external1}
```

pulls in the chunk named "external1" in external-chunks.R script. 


I tangle said document, `purl("mydoc.Rmd"), and the output script does not include the R code of the external chunks.  Is there some way I can make it do that?



(Note that the tangle'd output, mydoc.R, need not be the same as "external-chunks.R" since I can reuse only a subset of the external chunks, and may change the order of their use, etc.  I acknowledge this workflow is a bit convoluted but would be happy to justify it to the curious). 

Thanks!

- Carl

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] tangle/purl code included from external chunks
parts:
I'm aware of the problem: https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues/607
This will require a change of the design, so it is unlikely to happen
very soon. For your specific case, my suggestion is to use a chunk
hook instead. Here is a quick example:

unlink('my_report.R')
opts_chunk$set(purl = TRUE)
knit_hooks$set(purl = function(before, options, envir) {
if (before || !options$purl) return()
# write code after a chunk
cat(options$code, file = 'my_report.R', sep = '\n', append = TRUE)
})

I do not quite like the current design of purl(), since it is not
consistent with knit(). I'll think more about it in the future.

Regards,
Yihui
